review_method: Read all 132 complete actual 1 Samuel 19–23 source units in two untruncated full-source groups and every proposed retained target with necessary context. Separately displayed and reread all 137 complete source/target/category/rationale triples in six untruncated groups: chapter 19, chapter 20 split at verse 21, and chapters 21,22,23. Preserved exact initial TSV bytes and recorded 26 precise author refinements, mainly restoring proper-name capitalization after the Same-chapter prefix, plus narrowing the window-rescue heading, report-to-Saul attribution, running-boy reference and prose spacing. Then separately displayed and reread every complete corrected triple in two groups before freeze. Additional complete contexts read include Psalms 58:1–3/56:1–3/51:1–3/53:1–3/33:1–4, Matthew 12:1–5, Leviticus 24:5–9, Joshua 2:1–4/12–16, 2 Samuel 9:1–3/24:10–13, 1 Samuel 26:1/17:4/17:47–51/16:14/16:23/8:10–14/18:27/10:10–12 and Ruth 1:16–17. Links concern particular commands and performances, claims and responses, explicit later recitals, named offices and family ties, actual repeated phrases and contrasted reported assessments. Unusual wording and ambiguous pronouns remain unchanged; absent 23:12 is not supplied. The cave-heading comparison concerns the shared David cave-flight setting without identifying the unnamed cave episode. No exhaustive discovery, source-language, apparatus, independent human specialist, modern-site, clinical, ritual-mechanism or unresolved name-identity verification is claimed. After independent peer, separately displayed and reread two complete corrected triples: 20:30 names Saul as the person to whom David attributed motives, and 20:36 retains the unspecified object of past while the following unit names Jonathan as thrower. Preserved exact previous frozen TSV and author bytes; all 135 other rows unchanged, with zero added completion credit.
